title: GerManC - parsed corpus of German 1650-1800, 'Plays' text collection (OTA 2544)
notes: GerManC is the Leverhulme-funded (2005-2009) manually parsed corpus of German 1650-1800 sampled across nine text types and five 30-year periods; the 'Plays' collection (drama manuscripts and prints 1650-1700 in the harvest: 'GerManC drama 1673', '...1657', '...1699', '...1700') is deposited as a separate Oxford Text Archive record, ota:2544, in TEI-style XML with text and metadata; license CC-BY-NC (free distribution for non-commercial use with acknowledgment). The former project site germanc.lancs.ac.uk no longer responds (checked Oct 2026), so the OTA catalogue record (returning HTTP 200 behind an Anubis anti-bot gate) is the verified link. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: University of Manchester (Silke Regenbogen, Paul Bennett; superv. David Denison / Astrid Erdmann), deposited at the Oxford Text Archive (ota:2544)
